title: Body shape matters: Evidence from machine learning on body shape-income relationship.
summary: A graphical autoencoder derives 3D body-shape features that change estimated gender-specific family-income associations versus sparse classical measures; the result is observational and dated. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.ai_role: graphical autoencoder applied to 3D scans; deep-learned features used in income regressions and compared with classical anthropometrics, with bootstrap intervals and robustness checks.
